description: Production-ready WinUI 3 starter for .NET: a full MVVM desktop app (Mica window, system tray, auto-updates with Velopack/basic/none or native AppInstaller/Store options for MSIX, first-run setup wizard, SQLite + HTTP data layer, 3-language or English-only UI, persisted settings, Serilog/MEL/none logging, release pipeline) plus an MVVM content-page scaffolder. dotnet new devtem-winui / dotnet new devtem-page. Beyond blank templates: tray, i18n, deep links, settings backup, diagnostics.
title: DevTem WinUI 3 starter templates (MVVM desktop app + page)
